hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was scrubbing the hearth, my maid's scrub brush clutched tight, when I felt a tap on my shoulder. I turned to find Lady Eleanor, her silk gown glistening in the candlelight. She beckoned me with a smile, leading me to a hidden nook by the hearth. As I helped her lace her corset, she whispered secrets of the ballroom, her voice. I couldn't help but lean in closer, feeling the warmth of her breath on my cheek.
caption:
Lady Eleanor confiding in her maid. Who would have known she was a master of seduction? 🌹✨
